model: vep_v3.stan (T0018 v3), derived from T0011 v2 vep_ar1.stan sha f15d0a54 (diff vep_v3_vs_v2.diff)
build: CmdStan 2.40 via cmdstanpy 1.3.0; default stanc (O0, never --O1); cpp_options STAN_NO_RANGE_CHECKS=true, CXXFLAGS_OPTIM='-O3 -march=native' (appended to CXXFLAGS by stan math make/compiler_flags, equivalent to make/local CXXFLAGS+=)
log_density_check: lp_numpy_v3.py <exe> <data.json>: independent numpy (np.roots resting branch/z_eq, SC@x-rowsum*x coupling, offset marginalised as full MVN per PC) vs CmdStan log_prob at 6 random points
features: features.py (unchanged from v2, sha identical): compute_feature(seeg, time_steps, target_hz=2.0)
data: prep_data_v3.py <seeg.npz> <prefix>: baseline = first 5 s, centre = per-channel baseline median, k=24 PCs of full-window covariance of centred feature, Y=(Obs-base)V, GV=V'gain; free x0 = {max|gain| >= 0.25 max} U top-3 SC neighbours (40 for P1 gain/SC); other x0 fixed -2.5; dt=0.1, nsub=5, I1=3.1

priors.sigma_k: lognormal(log baseline SD of PC k, 1)

parameters: 40 x0 + K + tau0 + amp + 24 sigma + phi = 68

sampler.pathfinder: num_paths=32, draws=1000 (PSIS resampling, CmdStan defaults otherwise), seed=<seed>
sampler.nuts: 8 chains initialised from Pathfinder draws (create_inits), metric=dense_e, iter_warmup=400, iter_sampling=400, adapt_delta=0.9, max_treedepth=10, seed=<seed>
sampler.seeds: SYN-P1v3 arm A 18018, arm B (P2 SC) 28028, T0011 SYN-P1 arm A 38038; never re-run with new seeds to select a result

ranking: EZ ranking by posterior mean x0 over free regions; P(rank 1) per draw; per-chain (mode) top regions and mean lp
variants_tried_before_freeze: see T0018 task log: v3a (nsub 2, sigma_sd 1), v3b (nsub 2, sigma_sd 0.3), v3c (nsub 2, sigma_sd 0.5), v3d/e/f (nsub 5 with sigma_sd 0.3/0.5/1.0); frozen = v3f (prespecified sigma prior, nsub 5)
